preconditions.description: The input integer x must be an odd number within the range from 3 to 999,999.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith(str(q)) and all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of operations q, followed by q lines each describing a valid operation.

postconditions.expression: any('1' in line for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output must include at least one operation that results in the number 1 being on the blackboard.
The number of operations q must not exceed 100,000.
